name: Grocery Route Agent
description: An agent that turns a free-text Hebrew grocery list into the shortest walking route through a specific store. It normalizes the list, matches items to the store catalog via RAG, asks the user to resolve ambiguous items (HITL), computes an optimized route with a graph algorithm, and writes verified step-by-step walking instructions.
target_audience: Households and shoppers who do a weekly grocery run; supermarkets that want to offer in-store navigation
tasks_capable_of_performing: Normalizing free-text Hebrew shopping lists (typos, quantities, combined items)
Matching list items to a store product catalog (RAG)
Classifying unknown items to a likely store department
Computing the shortest in-store route (Dijkstra + 2-opt, melting items like ice cream last)
Loading a store from a simple Excel file: a map drawn in cells plus a product sheet, with validation messages in Hebrew
Maintaining a weekly shopping list across sessions
examples_of_suitable_questions: 2 חלב 3%, לחם אחיד, טחינה, עגבניות, גלידה
add שמפו, נוזל כלים  (ואחר כך: plan)
